title: Scenario 1: Normal Product Investigation
description: Standard balanced investigation with complete price and review history.
user_requirements: Active noise cancellation for work-from-home calls and travel

title: Scenario 2: Product with High User-Provided Price
description: Product is reputable but offered price is significantly higher than competitor benchmarks.

title: Scenario 3: Product with Highly Competitive Price
description: Price offered is below or at the lowest recorded marketplace rate.
user_requirements: Bass-heavy music and massive battery life

title: Scenario 4: Product with Missing Review Data
description: Catalog item with 0 verified customer reviews; tests sentiment resilience and confidence downgrading.

title: Scenario 5: Product with Incomplete Market Price Data
description: Item with no retailer market prices; tests edge-case handling for price benchmarks.
